name: 57 open-source web apps counted: screens, API operations and end-to-end spec files
description: 57 open-source web apps counted from their repositories: screens (page files or route declarations), API operations in a committed OpenAPI spec, and end-to-end spec files. 14 have no end-to-end spec file; 32 of the 40 with a screen count have fewer spec files than screens (median 0.25 per screen). Spec files are not tests and screens are not features. Counted 17 Sep 2026 and 28 Sep 2026, each row with its repository, commit and rule.
cite: featkpr, 57 open-source web apps counted, 28 Sep 2026, CC BY 4.0, https://featkpr.com/library/counted

t2.what: featkpr research report T2: 14 apps counted by hand

script.what: tools/library_count.py: T2's protocol made mechanical; 43 apps counted and 4 of T2's recounted
